freeze_stage: After full field/activity/missingness inventory, before group score or rank inspection
norm_status: Author-defined illustrative investigation concerns; not institutional policy or validated stakeholder preferences
amount_interpretation: Anonymised/recorded declaration amount is a stratification attribute, not actual processing cost, loss or recoverable savings. Zero retained as a distinct band; missing/nonfinite/negative values explicit invalid group.
parser_policy: Defused XML, DTD/entities/external entities forbidden, gzip streamed, original trace/event attributes retained, missing/duplicate case or event IDs and activity labels rejected, dates parsed UTC with invalid dates retained as missing evidence; no execution of supplied code.
endpoint_policy: First timestamp of each named activity family; if any occurrence of an endpoint family has missing/invalid timestamp, duration unevaluable; if an endpoint is absent, missing_prerequisite; negative first-to-first durations are invalid_temporal_order, not silently repaired or response paired.

criteria.name: Repeated recorded submission
criteria.interpretation: Repeated submissions, not proven avoidable rework

criteria.name: Recorded rejection observations
criteria.interpretation: Any recorded rejection including employee; not defect or culpability

criteria.name: Long first submission to first final-approval interval
Long first final approval to first payment-request interval
Long first payment request to first handled interval
Payment request without recorded handling
criteria.interpretation: Absence within available history, not proof of unpaid declaration; no verified extraction cutoff

criteria.name: Multiple recorded payment-handled events
criteria.interpretation: Multiple handling observations, not proven duplicate payment

reference: mean score of all scored declarations under each fixed population/view, before support filtering
volume: declaration count; no amount exposure multiplier
tie_policy: descending PI, descending scored support, lexical group key
exclusions: No mandatory role approval, individual-resource count, organisational ownership, causal root cause, financial balance or savings estimation; budget field constant and role-equivalence context absent.
